title: Trump says he has canceled a planned attack on Iran after reaching an agreement over the 'perimeters of a deal'
summary: The U.S. has canceled a planned military attack on Iran following an agreement with Iran and regional neighbors over preliminary deal terms. According to the president, the parties have agreed on foundational parameters of a potential agreement that prompted the decision to pause military action.
content: The U.S. president said Iran and its regional neighbors asked the U.S. to hold off any attacks after 'the perimeters of a deal has been agreed to'.

zh.title: 特朗普称在达成关于"交易边界"的协议后已取消对伊朗的计划性攻击
zh.summary: 美国在与伊朗和地区邻国就初步交易条款达成协议后，已取消对伊朗的计划性军事攻击。据总统表示，各方已就一项潜在协议的基本参数达成一致，这促使他们决定暂停军事行动。

title: An exam leak in India exposed a Gen Z jobs crisis that goes much deeper
summary: An exam leak in India sparked recent student protests, but underlying youth unemployment and limited job opportunities are the deeper drivers of Gen Z discontent. The incident has exposed systemic challenges in the job market affecting the country's younger generation.
content: While the leak of key exam papers was the trigger for the recent student protest in India, rising unemployment is the real fuel angering Gen Z in the country.

zh.title: 印度一起考试泄题事件暴露了Z世代就业危机的深层问题
zh.summary: 印度一起考试泄题事件引发了最近的学生抗议，但根本的青年失业和有限的就业机会是Z世代不满的更深层驱动力。该事件暴露了影响该国年轻一代的就业市场系统性挑战。

title: Parents save on school uniforms at city swap shop
summary: A pop-up swap shop is providing free school uniforms to parents, helping families reduce education costs. Organizers plan to establish this as a regular event to continue supporting households with back-to-school expenses.
content: Parents take home school uniform for free at a pop-up that organisers hope can become a regular event.

zh.title: 家长在城市交换活动中为学校制服节省开支
zh.summary: 一家临时交换店向家长提供免费学校制服，帮助家庭减少教育成本。组织者计划将其建立为定期活动，继续支持家庭的返校开支。

title: Capital One says it closed Trump Organization's accounts after anti-money laundering probe
summary: Capital One disclosed it closed accounts belonging to the Trump Organization following an anti-money laundering probe, marking the first public instance of a major bank formally linking money-laundering concerns to Trump's business interests. This development highlights regulatory scrutiny of the Trump Organization's financial practices.
content: The disclosure marks the first time a bank has formally tied money-laundering concerns to U.S. President Donald Trump's family business.

zh.title: 美国银行Capital One称在反洗钱调查后关闭了特朗普组织的账户
zh.summary: 美国银行Capital One公开披露，在反洗钱调查后关闭了属于特朗普组织的账户，这是大型银行首次公开将洗钱疑虑与特朗普的商业利益正式联系起来。这一发展突显了监管机构对特朗普组织财务实践的审查。
